YUWANCARD-BLACKSMITH.title: Blacksmith
YUWANCARD-BLACKSMITH.pages.INITIAL.descr:
You enter a [gold]blacksmith's shop[/gold] filled with heat.
[sine]The furnace roars[/sine] as the [gold]blacksmith[/gold] swings their hammer.
They notice you and pause their work:
"Huh?"
YUWANCARD-BLACKSMITH.pages.INITIAL.optio: You have no cards to upgrade.
Choose [blue]2[/blue] cards to [jitter]fuse[/jitter] into a higher rarity card.
You don't have enough fusable cards.
YUWANCARD-BLACKSMITH.pages.UPGRADED.desc:
The blacksmith skillfully upgrades your cards.
"HUH!"
They wave goodbye.
YUWANCARD-BLACKSMITH.pages.FUSED.descrip: The blacksmith throws the two cards into the furnace. Sparks fly, and a brand new card emerges.
YUWANCARD-BLACKSMITH.pages.CANCELLED.des: You decide to leave the blacksmith's shop.
YUWANCARD-BLACKSMITH.pages.FUSE_FAILED.d: The fusion failed. The blacksmith shrugs helplessly.

Locked

The book reads: [green]"Without a sword, stepping on bugs just gets your shoes dirty."[/green]
Read the Sweeping Blade Passage
Choose an Attack card to enchant with [purple]Sweeping Blade[/purple].
Locked

You search your pockets but find no card suitable for sweeping.

The book reads: [blue]"Without a sword, sweeping just makes you dizzy."[/blue]
Read the Venomous Passage
Choose an Attack card to enchant with [purple]Venomous[/purple].
Locked

You search your pockets but find no card worth poisoning.

The book reads: [red]"Without a weapon, poison is just a waste."[/red]
YUWANCARD-SELF_HELP_BOOK.pages.ARTHROPOD:
You turn to the Arthropod Killer passage:
[green]"Bugs are many, but they all share one weakness—getting squashed!"[/green]

You learn the tricks for dealing with bugs. An illusion of shattering shells appears on your card.
YUWANCARD-SELF_HELP_BOOK.pages.SWEEPINGB:
You turn to the Sweeping Blade passage:
[blue]"One sword sweeps a thousand enemies! Though you might only need to sweep two or three."[/blue]

A tiny figure swinging a sword is drawn on the page. Your card seems to have learned this momentum.
You turn to the Venomous passage:
[purple]"Poison is the best seasoning—add some spice to your enemy's last meal!"[/purple]

You carefully apply the poison to your card. It begins to glow with an eerie purple light.
YUWANCARD-SELF_HELP_BOOK.pages.INITIAL.o: Read the Loyal Passage
Choose a card to enchant with [purple]Loyal[/purple].
Read the Loyal Passage

You search your pockets but find no card worthy of loyalty.

The book reads: [gold]"Without an object of loyalty, loyalty is just empty words."[/gold]
YUWANCARD-SELF_HELP_BOOK.pages.LOYAL.des:
You turn to the Loyal passage:
[gold]"Loyalty is the most precious quality—it will stay by your side forever!"[/gold]

A golden mark appears on your card, as if swearing allegiance to you.
YUWANCARD-SELF_HELP_BOOK.pages.INITIAL.o: Read the Bite Passage
Choose a card to enchant with [purple]Bite[/purple].
Locked

You search your pockets but find no card suitable for biting.

The book reads: [red]"Without a target, a bite is just an empty chomp."[/red]
YUWANCARD-SELF_HELP_BOOK.pages.BITE.desc:
You turn to the Bite passage:
[red]"Biting is the most primal attack—simple, direct, effective!"[/red]

A row of sharp teeth marks appears on your card, as if waiting for prey.
YUWANCARD-SELF_HELP_BOOK.pages.INITIAL.o: Read the Snake Passage
Choose a card to enchant with [purple]Snake[/purple].
Locked

You search your pockets but find no card suitable for the snake enchantment.

The book reads: [green]"Without a card, the snake has nothing to inhabit."[/green]
YUWANCARD-SELF_HELP_BOOK.pages.SNAKE.des:
You turn to the Snake passage:
[green]"The snake's venom lies in its endless supply!"[/green]

A winding snake shadow appears on your card, as if flicking its tongue.
YUWANCARD-HORIZON_EVENT.title: Horizon
YUWANCARD-HORIZON_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.de:
"A bosom friend afar brings a distant land near."

You feel a warm power surrounding you, as if friends from afar are waving to you.
YUWANCARD-HORIZON_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.op: Restore all HP. Gain [green]10[/green] Max HP.
YUWANCARD-HORIZON_EVENT.pages.CARD_ADDED:
A card glowing with golden light slowly floats into your hand.

"May this power help you go further."
YUWANCARD-HORIZON_EVENT.pages.HEALED.des:
Warm power flows into your body, and you feel unprecedentedly fulfilled.

"The road ahead is long, take care."
YUWANCARD-SKULL_GOLD_RUSH.title: Skull Gold Rush: 999% Drop Rate
Doot-doot-da-doot...

Three skeletons in top hats are performing a stiff, hypnotic dance in front of you, bobbing to a brainwashing beat. Green neon glow and a blinding '+999% DROP RATE' banner make your head spin.

The air reeks of cheap browser game ads.
Stand still for 3 minutes to obtain the Relic [gold]Skull Gold-Farming[/gold].
YUWANCARD-SKULL_GOLD_RUSH.pages.ALL.opti: Spend [gold]{DrawCost}[/gold] Gold for a 'Full-Screen Gold Burst.'
Your balance is below [gold]{DrawCost}[/gold]. The skeletons stop dancing and flash you a contemptuous grin.
This ad is too hypnotic. You decide to shut your eyes and flee before you get brainwashed.
YUWANCARD-SKULL_GOLD_RUSH.pages.DRAW_RES:
You insert [gold]{DrawCost}[/gold] Gold. As the 'Max Attack Speed' effect flashes...

Gold coins erupt across the screen! You scavenge [gold]{PrizeGold}[/gold] Gold. The skeletons change colors and dance even harder, as if chanting: 'One more spin! Double the drops!'
YUWANCARD-SKULL_GOLD_RUSH.pages.BROKE.de:
You insert your last [gold]{DrawCost}[/gold] Gold.

The flashes fade, leaving you with only [gold]{PrizeGold}[/gold] Gold. Your pockets are empty, yet the three skeletons continue their mocking dance, indifferent to your bankruptcy.
YUWANCARD-SKULL_GOLD_RUSH.pages.RELIC_OB:
You patiently watch the entire dance routine. Exactly three minutes later, a glowing red 'Gold Rush Artifact' drops at your feet.

The lead skeleton tips his hat and vanishes into a cloud of digital artifacts.
YUWANCARD-SKULL_GOLD_RUSH.pages.LEAVE.de: You cover your ears and run, muttering 'It’s all a scam' under your breath. You can still hear the faint, rhythmic 'Doot-doot-da' echoing behind you.
YUWANCARD-SUNKEN_STATUE_QUEST.title: Sunken Statue
YUWANCARD-SUNKEN_STATUE_QUEST.pages.INIT: You discover a sunken statue in the water. Its stone sword glows with a mysterious light, as if calling to you.
YUWANCARD-SUNKEN_STATUE_QUEST.pages.GRAB:
You reach out and grab the stone sword. It feels heavy, but a mysterious power flows into your body.

A quest begins...
YUWANCARD-SUNKEN_STATUE_QUEST.pages.DIVE: You dive into the water and find some gold coins. The cold water chills you to the bone.

YUWANCARD-ZHI_ZHAN_ZHI_SHANG.pages.INITI:
[red]Red King[/red] will descend upon Earth in 3 hours

YUWANCARD-ZHI_ZHAN_ZHI_SHANG.pages.RED_K:
A card glowing with red light slowly floats into your hand.

"His arrival, salvation or destruction..."
YUWANCARD-ZHI_ZHAN_ZHI_SHANG.pages.PIG_B:
A card with an enticing aroma slowly floats into your hand.

"Sometimes, a burger is the best answer."
YUWANCARD-HELLO_HUMAN.title: Hello, Human.
YUWANCARD-HELLO_HUMAN.pages.INITIAL.desc:
You push open a door and find a glowing laptop sitting in the middle of the room. On the screen, four round little pink piglets are clinging to the edge, peering out at you. The one on the far right is holding up a red rose, as if greeting you. Warm sunlight spills through a window, and the whole scene radiates a soft, cozy tenderness that doesn't belong in the Spire.

[gold]"Hello there, person from the outside."[/gold] The leftmost piglet speaks, its voice soft as a marshmallow.
[gold]"Come stay with us for a while~"[/gold] The middle piglet wiggles its ears.
The rightmost piglet nudges the rose toward you, eyes sparkling.
YUWANCARD-HELLO_HUMAN.pages.INITIAL.opti: Take the rose and greet them
Chat with them for a while
Gain [gold]25[/gold] Gold. Gain the relic [gold]Soft Warmth[/gold].
Turn and leave, not disturbing their little world
Reach out and poke the piglet on the screen
Lose [red]5[/red] [gold]Max HP[/gold]. Gain the relic [gold]Piggy Doll[/gold].
YUWANCARD-HELLO_HUMAN.pages.TOOK_ROSE.de:
You take the red rose, but what your fingertips feel is a warm, fuzzy gentleness. The piglets hum a happy little tune, and the tension you've carried for so long quietly melts away.

[green]"Hehe, thanks for paying attention to us~"[/green]
YUWANCARD-HELLO_HUMAN.pages.CHATTED.desc:
You sit down by the laptop and listen to the piglets chatter about what they ate today and what they dreamed about. Time flies by. Before you leave, they secretly slip you a handful of gold from inside the screen as a "meeting gift."

[gold]"Come play again next time~"[/gold]
YUWANCARD-HELLO_HUMAN.pages.LEFT.descrip:
You can't bear to disturb their little world, so you gently close the door. Just before it shuts, you hear the piglets bid you farewell in unison.

That tenderness seems to have come along with you.
YUWANCARD-HELLO_HUMAN.pages.POKED.descri:
You can't help it. You reach out and poke the round cheek of the frontmost piglet. The screen ripples with a soft "boop," and the piglet's eyes go wide in surprise before it leaps out with a "plop," landing in your arms as a soft little doll.

[red](Poking through the screen seems to have cost you a bit of vitality...)[/red]
YUWANCARD-DOCTOR_PIG_EVENT.title: Doctor Pig
YUWANCARD-DOCTOR_PIG_EVENT.pages.INITIAL:
[gold]You sense an aura of scholarship. Looking up, you see a pig wearing a doctoral cap...
"There is no end to learning..... Will you accept my inheritance of knowledge...."[/gold]
Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]5[/blue] random pig colorless cards to add to your [gold]deck[/gold].
YUWANCARD-DOCTOR_PIG_EVENT.pages.ACCEPTE: Choose a card to add to your deck
YUWANCARD-DOCTOR_PIG_EVENT.pages.HAT_SNA: [gold]The doctor pig turns into an ordinary pig....[/gold]
